_about: Phrases Neeraja can clearly pick out by ear, and will annotate. Overlaps the tanarang/libmogra DB but is not bound by it: entries may be modified, shortened, or new. This file, not the DB, is the source of truth for annotation.

_format.id: <Raag>#<n> mirrors a libmogra mukhyanga index; <Raag>#N<n> is Neeraja's own
_format.phrase: space-separated swars; ',' prefix = mandra saptak, '`' prefix = taar saptak
_format.source: tanarang = verbatim from libmogra's RaagDB; neeraja = chosen/modified by hand
_format.annotate: include in the S3 annotation rounds
